parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
aggregate[ˈæɡrɪɡət]adj.
When a number is aggregate, it is made up of smaller amounts added together.
→ The company totaled its aggregate sales for the entire year.
😎
antibiotic[ˌæntibaɪˈɑːtɪk]n.
An antibiotic is a medical drug used to kill bacteria and treat infections.
→ The doctor gave me a shot of an antibiotic when I got the flu.
😎
circuit[ˈsɜːrkɪt]n.
A circuit is a piece of an electronic device that allows electricity to flow.
→ Be very careful not to shock yourself when fixing an electrical circuit.
😎
complement[ˈkɑːmplɪment]v.
To complement something or someone is to make them better.
→ The wool scarf complemented her lovely eyes.
😎
compress[kəmˈpres]v.
To compress something means to press or squeeze it so that it takes up less space.
→ I compressed my clothes to fit into a single suitcase.
😎
database[ˈdeɪtəbeɪs]n.
A database is a collection of data that is stored in a computer.
→ The company has a database of all the names and accounts of their customers.
😎
equivalent[ɪˈkwɪvələnt]n.
An equivalent is an amount or value that is the same as another amount or value.
→ I worked the equivalent of sixty hours this week.
😎
immune[ɪˈmjuːn]adj.
When someone is immune to a disease, they cannot be affected by it.
→ Children usually get shots to make them immune to certain diseases.
😎
input[ˈɪnpʊt]n.
Input is information that is put into a computer.
→ Type the input into the computer program.
😎
intimate[ˈɪntɪmət]adj.
When a relationship is intimate, the two things are very closely connected.
→ I only tell my secrets to my most intimate friends.
😎
magnet[ˈmæɡnət]n.
A magnet is a piece of iron or other material which attracts iron toward it.
→ I used a magnet to pick up the nails that were scattered on the floor.
😎
metabolism[məˈtæbəlɪzəm]n.
A person’s metabolism is the way chemical processes in their body use energy.
→ If you exercise every day, your metabolism speeds up.
😎
microchip[ˈmaɪkroʊtʃɪp]n.
A microchip is a small device inside a computer that holds information.
→ I can put more data on my computer if I buy a more powerful microchip.
😎
phase[feɪz]n.
A phase is a stage in a process or the gradual development of something.
→ The first phase in the recycling project involves finding volunteers to help out.
😎
pinch[pɪntʃ]v.
To pinch means to take a piece of skin between one’s fingers and squeeze.
→ I pinched my nose, so I couldn’t smell the odor from the garbage.
😎
prevalent[ˈprevələnt]adj.
When something is prevalent, it is common.
→ Growing a beard is more prevalent behavior in men than women.
😎
quantum[ˈkwɑːntəm]adj.
When something is quantum, it relates to the behavior of atomic particles.
→ The physics student studied quantum mechanics.
😎
ratio[ˈreɪʃioʊ]n.
A ratio is a relationship between two things expressed in numbers or amounts.
→ The boy to girl ratio is one to three.
😎
spiral[ˈspaɪrəl]n.
A spiral is a shape which winds round and round in a larger and larger circle.
→ A strand of DNA looks like two interlocking spirals.
😎
viral[ˈvaɪrəl]adj.
When something is viral, it is a disease or infection that is caused by a virus.
→ The girl was in bed for a week when she had a viral infection.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: Where would you find a microchip?
questions.explanation: "microchip" (vi mạch) được tìm thấy trong máy tính xách tay (laptop).

questions.content: What is found at a quantum level?
questions.explanation: "quantum" (lượng tử) liên quan đến các hạt nguyên tử (atomic particles).

questions.content: What does a magnet attract?
questions.explanation: "magnet" (nam châm) hút kim loại (metal).

questions.content: What is an example of a ratio?
questions.explanation: "ratio" (tỷ lệ) là tỷ số giữa các con số, ví dụ như hai trên một (two to one).

questions.content: What is the equivalent of 60 minutes?
questions.explanation: "equivalent" (tương đương) của 60 phút là 1 giờ (one hour).

sections.title: Exercise 2: Fill in the blanks with the correct words.

questions.content: The doctors just found out that the infection is _______ .
questions.explanation: "viral" (do virus) bổ nghĩa cho danh từ infection.

questions.content: Since a virus is not a bacteria, it cannot be treated with a(n) _______ .
questions.explanation: "antibiotic" (thuốc kháng sinh) không điều trị được virus mà chỉ trị được vi khuẩn.

questions.content: He looked at the information that was stored in the _______ .
questions.explanation: "database" (cơ sở dữ liệu) là nơi lưu trữ thông tin.

questions.content: After comparing the data, he expressed the results in a _______ .
questions.explanation: "ratio" (tỷ lệ) dùng để biểu thị kết quả so sánh số liệu.

questions.content: The process of building the house is in the final _______ .
questions.explanation: "phase" (giai đoạn) phù hợp với quy trình xây dựng (process).

questions.content: The last step is putting in a staircase in the shape of a _______ .
questions.explanation: "spiral" (hình xoắn ốc) phù hợp để chỉ hình dáng cầu thang.

questions.content: We learned what metals are attracted to a _______ .
questions.explanation: "magnet" (nam châm) hút kim loại.

questions.content: We fed our results into the computer as _______ .
questions.explanation: "input" (dữ liệu đầu vào) được đưa vào máy tính.

questions.content: In this country, polio is not _______ .
questions.explanation: "prevalent" (phổ biến) ý chỉ căn bệnh bại liệt không còn phổ biến ở nước này.

questions.content: It is highly uncommon because most people are _______ thanks to vaccines.
questions.explanation: "immune" (miễn dịch) nhờ vào vắc-xin.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content:
Walking was the most common form of transportation in the big city. [ 16 ]

We are now ready to begin the first particular stage in the process. [ 17 ]

Do the doctors know if the condition is a disease caused by a virus? [ 18 ]

Some people don’t believe in taking drugs used to treat infections. [ 19 ]

We were offered a bottle of sparkling cider to go well with our meal. [ 20 ]

I seem to have lost some of the information that is put into a computer. [ 21 ]

I wish they wouldn’t store personal information in the collection of data in the computer. [ 22 ]

His grandmother loves to take a piece of skin and squeeze his cheeks. [ 23 ]

I don’t really understand my body’s way that chemical processes cause food to be used. [ 24 ]

A spring looks like a shape which winds round and round. [ 25 ]
questions.explanation: "common" (phổ biến) đồng nghĩa với prevalent.
"particular stage" (giai đoạn cụ thể) đồng nghĩa với phase.
"a disease caused by a virus" (bệnh do virus gây ra) đồng nghĩa với viral.
"drugs used to treat infections" (thuốc trị nhiễm trùng) đồng nghĩa với antibiotics.
"go well with" (bổ sung, làm cho tốt hơn) đồng nghĩa với complement.
"information that is put into a computer" đồng nghĩa với input (dữ liệu đầu vào).
"collection of data" (tập hợp dữ liệu) đồng nghĩa với database.
"take a piece of skin and squeeze" (véo da) đồng nghĩa với pinch.
"way that chemical processes cause food to be used" đồng nghĩa với metabolism (sự trao đổi chất).
"shape which winds round and round" (hình cuộn vòng) đồng nghĩa với spiral.

sections.title: Exercise 4: Write Correct if the italicized word is used correctly. Write Incorrect if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: The microchip was damaged when she spilled water on the computer.
questions.explanation: "microchip" (vi mạch máy tính) dùng chính xác, nước làm hỏng máy tính.

questions.content: Quantum mechanics deals with planets and stars.
questions.explanation: "quantum mechanics" (cơ học lượng tử) liên quan đến các hạt vi mô, không phải hành tinh.

questions.content: People with fast metabolisms are usually thin and in good shape.
questions.explanation: "metabolisms" (sự trao đổi chất) dùng chính xác cho việc giữ vóc dáng.

questions.content: I compressed the sponge into a little ball.
questions.explanation: "compressed" (nén lại) dùng chính xác cho việc nắn miếng bọt biển.

questions.content: You should pinch your homework if you want to get it turned in on time.
questions.explanation: "pinch" (véo, kẹp) không dùng cho việc hoàn thành bài tập về nhà.

questions.content: I was amazed by the aggregate total of donated gifts and money.
questions.explanation: "aggregate" (tổng số) dùng đúng khi nói về tổng tiền và quà quyên góp.

questions.content: The children played all day on the circuit.
questions.explanation: "circuit" (mạch điện) không phải là nơi trẻ em có thể chơi đùa.

questions.content: Dressing and pepper complemented the tasty salad.
questions.explanation: "complemented" (bổ sung, làm tôn lên) dùng đúng cho gia vị món salad.

questions.content: Intimate friends should not tell lies about each other.
questions.explanation: "intimate" (thân thiết) dùng chính xác cho tình bạn.

questions.content: This tuba is the equivalent of a set of drums.
questions.explanation: "equivalent" (tương đương) dùng sai vì kèn tuba và dàn trống không thể tương đương nhau về số lượng hay âm thanh.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
Microchips

The bond between humans and computers is becoming more intimate than ever before. Scientists are now putting microchips inside people's bodies. They are made up of compressed electrical circuits that can detect and record data about the body. They are tiny, but they hold the equivalent amount of data as most computers.

A microchip is put to use inside a person with a simple procedure. First, a doctor must put data about the patient onto a chip. Input about the person's age, race, gender, and medical history is stored on the chip. The second phase of the process involves putting it in the person's skin. The doctor pinches a piece of skin and cuts a tiny hole with a tool shaped like a spiral. The chip is inserted, and the skin is allowed to heal. At last, it begins the task of putting data into its database.

Microchips scan the patient's body to record what is happening on the quantum level. They can find problems with the person's metabolism and organs. They can also detect viral infections. They can find the aggregate number of immune and infected cells and present the results in a ratio. They can even tell doctors what type of antibiotic to give to the patient!

To recover the chip's data, the doctor uses a special magnet that copies it. This way, the doctor can put the information from the chip onto a computer. Then they can find out exactly what is wrong with the person.

The idea of putting chips in humans is still very new. However, it is now becoming more prevalent. Scientists and doctors are hopeful about the future uses of microchips. Someday, all new babies might get a microchip soon after they are born. Doctors will be able to know about any problems from the very beginning. It is obvious that medicine and computers complement each other well.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement True or False.

questions.content: Microchips are made up of compressed electrical circuits.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 của bài viết chỉ ra rằng "They are made up of compressed electrical circuits that can detect and record data about the body." (Chúng được tạo thành từ các mạch điện nén có thể phát hiện và ghi lại dữ liệu về cơ thể). Thông tin này trùng khớp hoàn toàn.

questions.content: Chips express the aggregate number of immune and intimate cells in a ratio.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 3, bài đọc viết "They can find the aggregate number of immune and infected cells and present the results in a ratio." (Chúng có thể tìm ra tổng số tế bào miễn dịch và tế bào bị nhiễm bệnh rồi trình bày kết quả dưới dạng tỷ lệ). Câu hỏi nói về tế bào thân mật (intimate cells) thay vì tế bào nhiễm bệnh (infected cells), nên câu này là sai.

questions.content: Chips detect viral infections and problems with people’s metabolism.
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn 3 có ghi "They can find problems with the person's metabolism and organs. They can also detect viral infections." (Chúng có thể tìm ra các vấn đề về quá trình trao đổi chất và các cơ quan của con người. Chúng cũng có thể phát hiện bệnh truyền nhiễm do virus). Câu này tóm tắt đúng chức năng của chip.

questions.content: A doctor pinches the skin and cuts a hole with a tool shaped like a spiral.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 2 miêu tả quá trình cấy ghép "The doctor pinches a piece of skin and cuts a tiny hole with a tool shaped like a spiral." (Bác sĩ véo một mảnh da và cắt một lỗ nhỏ bằng một dụng cụ có hình xoắn ốc). Điều này hoàn toàn đúng.

questions.content: Putting antibiotics in humans is becoming more prevalent.
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn cuối, bài đọc nói "The idea of putting chips in humans is still very new. However, it is now becoming more prevalent." (Ý tưởng cấy chip vào cơ thể người vẫn còn rất mới. Tuy nhiên, nó đang dần trở nên phổ biến hơn). Cái ngày càng phổ biến là việc cấy chip, chứ không phải là cho con người dùng thuốc kháng sinh (antibiotics).

questions.content: What does the doctor’s special magnet do?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4 cho biết "To recover the chip's data, the doctor uses a special magnet that copies it." (Để lấy lại dữ liệu của chip, bác sĩ sử dụng một nam châm đặc biệt để sao chép nó). Vì vậy, nam châm có tác dụng sao chép dữ liệu.

questions.content: What holds the equivalent amount of storage as most computers?
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn 1 có viết "They are tiny, but they hold the equivalent amount of data as most computers." (Chúng rất nhỏ, nhưng chứa lượng dữ liệu tương đương với hầu hết các máy tính). Từ They ở đây chính là đang nhắc tới Microchips.

questions.content: After the input is stored on the chip, what is the next phase of the process?
options: Putting it underneath the person's skin
questions.explanation: Theo đoạn 2, "The second phase of the process involves putting it in the person's skin." (Giai đoạn thứ hai của quá trình bao gồm việc đặt nó vào dưới da của người bệnh). Đây là bước ngay sau khi lưu dữ liệu.

questions.content: What do microchips do to record what is happening on the quantum level?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 có nhắc "Microchips scan the patient's body to record what is happening on the quantum level." (Các vi mạch quét cơ thể bệnh nhân để ghi lại những gì đang xảy ra ở cấp độ lượng tử). Do đó, hành động chúng làm là quét cơ thể người bệnh.

questions.content: What complements each other, according to the passage?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối cùng của bài đọc kết luận "It is obvious that medicine and computers complement each other well." (Rõ ràng là y học và máy tính bổ sung cho nhau rất tốt). Vậy thứ bổ sung cho nhau là y học và công nghệ máy tính.
